A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
QDs linked with MPA to the TiO2 nanowire are not suitable candidates for QDSSC.
the electronic absorption spectrum is not affected by the size of the nanotubes but it is by the size of QD and by the type of the ligand.
the adsorption mode, size and ligands are the most important factors to control the absorption spectrum and the charge separation in QDSSCs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the QDs should be saturated with ligands and that the ligand choice is crucial.
the QD's size and its adsorption to the nanotubes play a crucial role in the absorption of light, which is a key step in the photoconversion process.
the electronic structure of QDSSCs can be tuned to optimize the absorption spectrum.
